authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / local planning authority providers
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 7,512 article-4-direction-area records from 116 providers; its specification defines these as geometries for defined areas where local planning authorities withdraw specified permitted-development rights, with polygon or multipolygon geometry and permanent references. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round60 remote checkpoint/readback still exposes no authoritative article-4-direction-area reference, organisation/local-authority identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate area to this fixed slot. Choosing one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
